A read-only re-run of incident_observe.sh shows the default Dagu home unchanged since fix round 2 (auth/, contexts/ and the 27 created paths; nothing born or modified after 2026-09-22 23:26:00), so the recorded remove option still covers exactly the created paths.
checks.criteria: Unchanged if the find -newermt 23:26:00 list is empty and the top-level listing is the same seven entries. Detection: find -newermt compares mtime, so any write to a file or any entry added or removed in a directory after that time would be listed. No write, no rm.

checks.name: challenger-venv-lock
checks.expectation: `uv pip freeze` of the prefect-3.8.6 and temporalio-1.33.0 venvs lists the full resolved set (prefect has well over 50 distributions; temporalio has fewer than 15). Installed size of the prefect venv is below 200 MB, which would put the wheel download below the heavy-build threshold, since wheels are compressed and smaller than their installed trees.
checks.criteria: Recorded per venv: the freeze output, the distribution count, `du -sb` of the venv and of its site-packages, and the newest dist-info mtime compared with the original install time, to show that no later install changed the set. If any dist-info is newer than the original install, the freeze is labelled as the current set, not the executed set. If the prefect venv is 200 MB or more installed, the receipt says that the bounded-run rule was not followed for a tree that may have exceeded the threshold. Download bytes were not recorded at install time and cannot be recovered exactly; the installed size is an upper-bound proxy, not a measured download.

checks.name: codex-gate-timeout
checks.expectation: After the fix, codex_gate() raises instead of returning when 2 or more other real codex exec processes still run at max_wait, so no caller can make the model call. The matcher also counts `codex <global options> exec` and the `e` alias.
checks.criteria: A synthetic unittest (no model call): (a) with codex_exec_processes patched to always return 2 pids and max_wait=0.3 s, codex_gate raises CodexGateTimeout carrying the observation; (b) with 1 other pid it returns immediately with released_by_timeout absent or false; (c) two real processes spawned with argv[0]=codex and argv `codex -c <code> -c k=v exec` and `codex --profile p e` are both detected by codex_exec_processes, and a `codex login` decoy is not. Detection: (c) runs against /proc, the same source the gate reads; (a) must fail against the old helper, which returns with released_by_timeout=True.
